structure.note: square-code distinguisher needs the structured square to be smaller than m; here both counts exceed m, so the square generically fills the space (counting note, not a proof; the trace-GRS bound equals the square-distinguishability threshold C(rs+1,2) - s C(r-1,2) of Lemoine's tangent-space attack 2505.10184, which therefore does not apply either; the syzygy distinguisher of Randriambololona 2407.15740 is the relevant subexponential attack and is not run here)
